healthRecords.title: Skin and coat review
healthRecords.notes: Mild contact dermatitis on the flanks. Switched to a salmon-based diet and added an omega-3 supplement. Recheck in three weeks.

healthRecords.title: DHPP annual booster
healthRecords.notes: Administered without reaction. Next booster due May 2027.

healthRecords.title: Leptospirosis booster
healthRecords.notes: Annual booster. Monsoon exposure advised caution near stagnant water.

healthRecords.title: Rabies annual booster
healthRecords.notes: Certificate issued and added to the Pet Passport.

healthRecords.title: Annual wellness panel
healthRecords.notes: CBC and kidney and liver panel all within range. Mild elevation in eosinophils consistent with allergy.

healthRecords.title: Dental scaling and polish
healthRecords.notes: Grade 2 tartar removed under light sedation. Home brushing recommended three times a week.

healthRecords.title: Ear infection
healthRecords.notes: Yeast otitis in the left ear. Ten days of drops, resolved at recheck.

healthRecords.title: Lipoma removal
healthRecords.notes: Benign fatty lump removed from the right shoulder. Histopathology clear.

healthRecords.title: Summer coat and heat check
healthRecords.notes: Healthy weight. Advised early-morning exercise only and shaded rest during Bengaluru afternoons.

healthRecords.title: DHPP and Canine Influenza boosters
healthRecords.notes: Both boosters given together. Mild lethargy for one day, resolved.

healthRecords.title: Rabies annual booster
healthRecords.notes: Certificate issued.

healthRecords.title: Eye irritation
healthRecords.notes: Dust-related conjunctivitis. Lubricating drops for five days, no recurrence.

healthRecords.title: Genetic health screen
healthRecords.notes: Clear for common Husky eye conditions. Carrier for none of the tested markers.

healthRecords.title: Spay
healthRecords.notes: Uneventful laparoscopic spay. Healed fully at the ten-day check.

healthRecords.title: Orthopaedic follow-up
healthRecords.notes: Hip range of motion slightly reduced on the left. Continue glucosamine, start hydrotherapy twice a month.

healthRecords.title: DHPP annual booster
healthRecords.notes: Given without reaction.

healthRecords.title: Senior wellness panel
healthRecords.notes: Creatinine at upper normal. Repeat in six months and encourage water intake.

healthRecords.title: Leptospirosis booster
healthRecords.notes: Annual booster.

healthRecords.title: X-ray: hips and spine
healthRecords.notes: Early osteoarthritic change in both hips. Weight management and low-impact exercise plan issued.

healthRecords.title: Dental scaling
healthRecords.notes: One loose premolar extracted. Soft chews only for a week.

healthRecords.title: Hot spot
healthRecords.notes: Localised pyoderma on the thigh. Clipped, cleaned, antibiotics for ten days.

healthRecords.title: Dental check
healthRecords.notes: Gingivitis grade 1 to 2. Dental diet and gel advised, scaling to be planned if it progresses.

healthRecords.title: Rabies and FeLV boosters
healthRecords.notes: Both boosters given. Weight stable at 4.6 kg.

healthRecords.title: Tear staining management
healthRecords.notes: Blocked tear duct ruled out. Daily wipes and filtered water advised.

healthRecords.title: FVRCP annual booster
healthRecords.notes: Booster given. Next due September 2026.

healthRecords.title: Renal screen and PKD ultrasound
healthRecords.notes: No cysts detected. Kidney values normal. Repeat annually for Persian cats.

healthRecords.title: Sanitary trim and coat de-matting
healthRecords.notes: Heavy matting around the hindquarters removed. Daily combing routine agreed.

providers.name: Dr. Neha Kapoor
providers.about: Veterinarian at Indiranagar Vet Clinic with 11 years of practice. Focuses on preventive care, skin conditions and diet-led treatment plans.

providers.name: PawfectGroom Studio
providers.about: Fear-free grooming studio using hypoallergenic products and low-noise dryers. Certified groomers for double-coated and brachycephalic breeds.

providers.name: Dr. Arjun Menon
providers.about: Orthopaedic and soft-tissue surgeon with a special interest in senior large-breed dogs. Runs a weekly hydrotherapy clinic.

providers.name: Paws and Relax Boarding
providers.about: Climate-controlled suites, daily outdoor play and live camera access for owners. Vaccination credential verified at check-in.

providers.name: Coach Kabir Mehta
providers.about: Certified behaviourist using positive-reinforcement methods. Sessions held at your home or in Cubbon Park.

providers.name: Walk with Ravi
providers.about: Verified walker with GPS route reports and photo updates after every walk. Trained in canine first aid.

providers.name: Happy Tails Pet Taxi
providers.about: Pet-safe cabs with travel crates and seat covers. Door-to-door transfers to clinics, groomers and the airport.

providers.name: Bark and Bubbles Mobile Grooming
providers.about: Fully equipped grooming van that arrives at your door. Ideal for anxious pets and seniors who dislike travel.

providers.name: Dr. Shreya Nair
providers.about: Feline-only veterinarian advising on Persians, Himalayans and other flat-faced breeds. Offers video follow-ups within 48 hours.

providers.name: Pawsitive Academy
providers.about: Weekend group classes capped at 8 dogs. Includes an agility course and socialisation hour.

providers.name: The Dog House Retreat
providers.about: Farm-style retreat with large paddocks, vet on call and a dedicated senior wing with orthopaedic bedding.

providers.name: Sitters and Co
providers.about: Background-checked sitters who handle feeding, medication and play in your own home.

providers.name: Global Paws Relocation
providers.about: End-to-end pet relocation. Health certificates, import permits, airline booking and door-to-door delivery handled by one coordinator.

providers.name: Pawport Movers
providers.about: Domestic pet relocation by climate-controlled road transport with live location updates and a vet check at pickup and drop.

providers.name: RescuePaws 24/7 Pet Ambulance
providers.about: Fully equipped pet ambulance with a trained paramedic, oxygen and stabilisation kit. Average arrival in 18 minutes within the city.

providers.name: CityVet Emergency Response
providers.about: Round-the-clock emergency transfer between homes and 24-hour veterinary hospitals, with a vet on call for the journey.

posts.content: Coco just nailed her first agility course at Pawsitive Academy! So proud of this girl.
Any recommendations for hypoallergenic cat food in Bengaluru? Our rescue tabby is scratching a lot.
Sunrise walk at Cubbon Park with the whole pack. Golden hour never gets old.
Monsoon reminder: leptospirosis cases rise every October. Keep boosters current and avoid stagnant water on walks.
Simba met the new puppy in our building today and they are best friends already.
Persian parents: what is your daily eye-cleaning routine? Looking for gentle wipes that actually work.
Adoption drive this Sunday at Lalbagh. Eleven rescues are looking for homes. Come say hi.
Switched to a GPS collar after Max slipped his harness on a walk. Geofence alerts are worth every rupee.
Training tip: five minutes of recall practice before every meal beats a long weekend session.
Husky owners, how do you keep them cool in Bengaluru afternoons? Luna and I are sharing tips below.
Our 12 year old beagle did a full 5 km today. Joint supplements and patience really work.
First vet visit for our rescue kitten. Tiny, brave and already purring in the waiting room.
Photo dump from last weekend's pet-friendly cafe crawl in Indiranagar.
Fostering update: Mocha is now confident enough to share the sofa with two dogs.
Retriever rescue group meets every first Sunday. All breeds and mixes welcome.
Bruno's first swim of the season. Bella watched from a safe distance, unimpressed.
